items.comment: "makes" is the support verb in "makes the greatest possible efforts". The substantive claim is represented by `effort_by(SolactiveGreatestPossibleEfforts, Solactive)` and `greatest_possible(SolactiveGreatestPossibleEfforts)`; no separate action predicate is needed.

"in order to" marks purpose. The purpose is represented directly by `procedure_maintains(..., ContinuedReliability)` and `procedure_maintains(..., Comparability)`, so `order` does not need a standalone carrier.

"Nevertheless" is a discourse contrast marker between the methodology-adaptation claim and the fallback cessation condition. The contrast is accounted for by representing both claims separately: adaptation where necessary, and orderly cessation when no other options are available. It does not introduce a standalone domain object, relation, or formula.

"other" occurs in "no other options are available". The exclusion is represented by `count(o in Option where available_option_for_index(o, i)) = 0`; adding a separate `other` concept would duplicate the zero-option condition.

"indicated" appears in "may be indicated". The source is modal/optional, so the IR intentionally avoids a hard `indicated(c)` outcome. The indication is represented by `permission indicate_orderly_cessation(...)` plus `orderly_cessation_indication_available(i)` under the no-options fallback condition.
"way" is part of the phrase "in a way not foreseeable". The formal content is represented by the negated foreseeability relations at inception; `way` adds no separate domain object.

"particularly" emphasizes that selection criteria are included among index rules. The inclusion is already explicit through `SelectionCriteria extends IndexRule`; no separate emphasis predicate is needed.
"can" is an auxiliary in "can no longer be applied coherently". The operative condition is represented by `not applied_coherently(r, i)` rather than by a separate modality.

"longer" appears in "no longer be applied" and "no longer used". The loss of applicability/use is represented by negated predicates and negated existence of underlying-value uses; `longer` does not introduce an additional temporal trace in this local IR.

"how" introduces the content of the guidelines: identifying situations, procedures for informing stakeholders, procedures for consulting stakeholders, and termination/transition procedures. These are represented explicitly by `guidelines_identify`, `procedure_for_informing`, `procedure_for_consulting`, the shared `Stakeholders` carrier, and procedure relations.
